   OR p.position <> 'Backcourt'

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WITH DISTINCT p, t, c, o
WHERE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0
   OR p.position <> 'Backcourt'
   OR c.gdp = '252200'
RETURN p.position AS col1,
       CASE
         WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
         WHEN date_part('month', date('2026-10-14')) > date_part('month', date(o.birth_date))
           OR (date_part('month', date('2026-10-14')) = date_part('month', date(o.birth_date))
               AND date_part('day', date('2026-10-14')) >= date_part('day', date(o.birth_date)))
         THEN date_part('year', date('2026-10-14')) - date_part('year', date(o.birth_date))
         ELSE date_part('year', date('2026-10-14')) - date_part('year', date(o.birth_date)) - 1
       END AS col2,
       CAST(t.championships AS INT64) AS col3,
       c.city_name AS col4,
       p.name AS name_player,
       t.team_name AS name_team,
       o.name AS name_manager,
       c.city_name AS name_city

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WITH DISTINCT p, t, c, o
WHERE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0
   OR p.position <> 'Backcourt'
   OR c.gdp = '252200'
WITH p, t, c, o,
     CAST(NULLIF(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '[0-9]{4}', 0), '') AS INT64) AS birth_year
RETURN p.position AS col1,
       CASE WHEN birth_year IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 2026 - birth_year END AS col2,
       CAST(t.championships AS INT64) AS col3,
       c.city_name AS col4,
       p.name AS name_player,
       t.team_name AS name_team,
       o.name AS name_manager,
       c.city_name AS name_city
